semantic_scope.bag_set: Fig7 has DISTINCT/UNION ALL and duplicate-sensitive operators; no claim that all SQL dialect behavior is covered.
semantic_scope.null: Fig7 includes Null/IsNull; official example README contains None; expression guide encodes value/nullability pairs. This is positive NULL-related evidence, not an implementation audit.
semantic_scope.aggregate: Fig7 includes COUNT, MIN, MAX, SUM, AVG, GROUP BY, arithmetic, outer joins, subqueries, ORDER BY.
semantic_scope.pk_fk: P3 declares PKeys/FKeys plus explicit distinct/eq/etc constraints; P6 has primary-key distinct example. Comprehensive PK/FK semantics and consistency of declared vs operational constraints NOT_AUDITED.
semantic_scope.bound: P1 §3.3 symbolic n-tuples permit deletion: at most n rows per input table, not exact-N. Theorem3.12 completeness is relative to those bounded semantics.
semantic_scope.proofs: P1 §3.8 states soundness/completeness; AppendixC proof text exists. This audit locates statements only; CHECKED_PROOF=false.

fewrows.title: Few Rows Tell Them Apart: Equivalence of Queries Mixing Set and Bag Semantics

publication.status: 2026 preprint, not a DKE publication established here

sources.locators: §2; §3 Prop5/Lemma6/Thm7/Example8; §4 Thms13,15; §5 Thms18,23; §7; Use of AI Tools

task_and_novelty.task: Compute fragment-specific completeness thresholds for mixed DISTINCT/bag-set conjunctive query equivalence over set-valued stored relations.
task_and_novelty.novelty: Characteristic multiplicity-polynomial monomial and Boolean-corner extraction yield width-sensitive counterexample size; refine under keys and constrained comparisons.

semantic_scope.base: Set-valued stored relations; duplicates arise in answers, not duplicate stored tuples (§2).
semantic_scope.language: Safe conjunctive relational/order atoms with distinguished, set and multiset variables; no general SQL parser/engine is presented.
semantic_scope.count: §2 relates answer multiplicities to COUNT(*)/COUNT(DISTINCT...) and says adding that aggregate preserves equivalence.
semantic_scope.general_aggregation: §7 lists extension to further query classes, aggregation foremost, as future work; do not claim general SUM/AVG/HAVING/outer-join coverage.
semantic_scope.pk_fk: Thm13 requires key-anchorable relational queries/key-reduct+key-chase; Thm15 requires acyclic FK and key-anchorable chased queries. No arbitrary cyclic FK completeness inferred.
semantic_scope.null: No SQL NULL/3VL formalization established by §2 syntax/semantics. Do not transfer theorem to NULL-sensitive SQL without a separate embedding proof.
semantic_scope.comparisons: Thm18 certified var-constant position-groups (directed/retained/isolated with boundary-free handling); Thm23 pinned comparisons with key-anchorable comparison-free bodies and set-equivalence. Not unrestricted comparisons.

bounds.theorem13: replace width by key-width after key-reduct/key-chase for admitted queries
bounds.theorem15: 2^kw max(|Qhat|,|Q'hat|) for admitted FK-chased queries; unchanged width factor does NOT mean original unchased query size is unchanged
bounds.boolean_corner: a in {1,2}^m sizes the fresh-value block for each multiset variable; NOT per-table row bound2.
bounds.tightness: Example8 distinguishes corner necessity from database-size tightness: theorem permits16 atoms, canonical all-two corner9, smaller witness3. These are author-reported examples, not recomputed.
